preconditions.description: The length of the interview string n must be between 1 and 100.
The length of the string s must be equal to n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must consist only of lowercase English letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the string s with all occurrences of the filler word 'ogo' replaced by '***'.
If the string s contains the filler word 'ogo', it must be replaced in the output.
If the string s does not contain the filler word 'ogo', the output must be the same as the input.
